name: benchmark1_1_release_ur_1rgb_pick_up_the_flowers_from_the_table_1030
description: A robotics-oriented dataset that evaluates a model's ability to visually perceive and execute a pick-up manipulation: specifically picking up flowers from a table using an RGB sensor on a UR robot. The benchmark measures perception-to-action alignment, grasp planning correctness, and successful task completion under realistic table settings and varied object arrangements. It focuses on closed-loop visuomotor control from RGB input for a single manipulation primitive.
reputation: A niche BAAI DataCube benchmark used in robotics research and internal evaluations, with limited widespread adoption outside that community.
